plugins.name: Amanamu Void Alert
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Marks Amanamu's Void abyss monsters with a ring, a label and an edge arrow whose colour shows whether the monster is still in its void cloud.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
The buff option names the buff as the game does: "Amanamu's Void".

plugins.name: Auto My Aim
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Moves the cursor onto the best monster near you while you hold a key or after a toggle, so skills cast at it; line of sight, rarity and life priority.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).

plugins.name: Belt Toggle On Buff
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Re-equips your belt automatically (open inventory, two clicks, close) when a Walker monster dies near you or a new stolen-modifier buff appears.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
A long text typed in another alphabet (Cyrillic, Thai, Chinese) is no longer cut in the middle of a letter.

plugins.name: Buff Overlay
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows chosen buffs and skill states as icons, charges, time left or custom text anywhere on screen, with a live preview and drag-to-place.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
A long text typed in another alphabet (Cyrillic, Thai, Chinese) is no longer cut in the middle of a letter.

plugins.name: Example Plugin
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Reference plugin for developers: live demos of every SDK service, from entities, buffs and inventories to the game UI tree, memory and prices.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
Columns and fields size themselves to the translated text instead of pixel widths made for English, and long translated labels keep every switch, tab and section working.
Entity types are shown by their SDK names, the same names as in the type filter.
Game terms read as the game names them in each language (for example the Magic rarity and implicit modifiers in Russian, the skill names in the Skills tab).

plugins.name: Farm Counter
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Records your map runs: loot value, map time, kills, gold and XP per hour, with run history and statistics per map type.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
The notes in the Settings tab wrap at the tab's edge instead of running past it, and the "Visible item rows" slider leaves room for its label in a narrow tab.

Loot is priced in every game language: items are priced by the item itself, not by the name the game shows (POEFixer 371 and later; an older POEFixer prices by name as before). A custom price set under an item's English name also applies.
Each backpack item is priced once per area and price update instead of on every backpack read, so a full backpack costs no frame time.

The Custom Prices tab lists as unpriced only the items the counter could not price: an item priced in a non-English game is no longer listed there (a custom price set on its game name would have replaced its market price).
The kill counter's monster icons appear on a fresh install as soon as POEFixer has downloaded them, and follow later icon updates without a restart.
The trend chart's date range no longer cuts a translated "unknown date" text in the middle of a character.

plugins.name: Follow Bot
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: A follower that keeps up with your leader through areas and portals, fights, loots and stashes by your rules, and recovers from getting stuck.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
The decision log's Copy button copies the English text, as the log file holds it, so a bug report reads the same in every language.

Works in every game language: with POEFixer 371 or newer, ground loot is priced by what the item is, not by the name your client shows, so the value rules work with any client language (and two items that share one translated name get their own prices).
The decision log's filter also finds a line by its English words, as the log file and the Copy button show it.
Rules made with Add or Duplicate and profiles made with New or Duplicate keep their names in the program language: switching the language no longer leaves them in the language they were made in.
The "Find UI by control name" match list fits its longest translated choice.

Texts that name a button or hotkey use its label exactly (Russian, Japanese, Korean and Spanish); Traditional Chinese uses the game's word for a portal (時空之門), Japanese the game's word for a town portal (タウンポータル).
UI dumps and "Find UI" results cut a long game text between characters, never inside one.
An item POEFixer could not price by what it is yet (its item data still downloading) is priced again a second later, instead of keeping the price of its name for the rest of the area.
A renamed profile with a long Cyrillic or Thai name is cut between letters, never inside one.

plugins.name: Foretold Rewards
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows the priced rewards the Rite of the Nameless can offer on each atlas map, so you can plan your route before you run it.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
The notes in the settings tabs (the lock hint, exclusions, prices and performance) wrap at the tab's edge instead of running past it.

The reward search also matches the English reward names in every language, so the default "Mageblood" and searches typed in English find their chains in every program language (a search typed in another language finds them while that language is shown); the reward picker and its Browse list match the English names too.
Searches, the reward picker and the chain filter ignore letter case in every alphabet (Cyrillic, accented letters), not only in English.
The result order and colours of a search stay the same after the program language changes.
A long search no longer ends in a broken character when it fills the search box.

plugins.name: Get Back My Zoom
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Restores a much further camera zoom-out, removes Atlas fog, reveals the whole map and enlarges the light radius, safely undone when switched off.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).

plugins.name: GGPK Explorer
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Browses the game's content files: searchable file tree, viewers for tables, images, models and audio, and file extraction.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
In a narrow tab the load status moves to its own line and the empty file tree's note wraps, so neither is cut off.

Works in every game language: the table definitions come from the game data the program installs and updates, and load again when it updates them; until they arrive the table views show "Waiting for game data". The text viewer keeps its monospace font after the program changes language.

The Skill Tree and its Metadata tab wait for the table definitions too ("Waiting for game data") and open as soon as they arrive, instead of staying on an error when a skill tree file was opened first.
Table definitions that arrived but could not be read show why on every view that needs them, instead of "Waiting for game data" for ever; they are read again when the program updates them.
Long lines in the search results are cut between characters, never inside one.

plugins.name: Ground Effects
plugins.author: 1k4ru5g3, POEFixer
plugins.description: Draws coloured circles on dangerous ground effects (shocked, chilled, ignited ground, caustic clouds and your own rules) at their real size.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
A long text typed in another alphabet (Cyrillic, Thai, Chinese) is no longer cut in the middle of a letter.

plugins.name: Ninja Pricer
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows item prices on dropped items, in your inventory and stash, in the Ritual shop and on Runeshape rewards.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
Hotkey names show correctly with a non-English keyboard layout.

Prices work in every game language: items in the inventory, the stash and on the ground are priced by the item itself, not by the name the game shows (POEFixer 371 and later; an older POEFixer prices by name as before).
The Runeshape Combinations panel is found, and its reward quantities read, in every game language.
The selected display currency is not priced on itself in a non-English game either, also in the Runeshape Combinations panel.

The combination weights in the Runeshape Combinations panel appear in every game language: a row is matched to its reward by quantity, recipe size and price when the game shows the reward's name in another language.
The Runeshape tooltip in Traditional Chinese uses the game's word for remnant, and the Debug panel keeps the SDK field name Zone in every language.

plugins.name: Pick My Loot
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Picks up the ground items you tick, or anything above a price you set, nearest first, using POEFixer prices; pauses on panels, enemies, town or menu.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
Works in every game language (POEFixer 371 and later): ticks, prices and new league items go by each item's English name, and an item seen on the ground is listed as the game words it.
Waystones and Precursor Tablets the item list does not know are filed by their game path, whatever the game language.

An item on the ground the program could not name yet (its item data still downloading) is asked again a second later, so it is picked by its English name once that arrives instead of by the game's name until the next area.

plugins.name: Quick Stash
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: One-click Transfer from your backpack into the open stash, vendor or trade window, and TAKE from the stash by the game's own item search.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
"Automatic" mod text language takes the game language POEFixer knows (POEFixer 371 and later); an older POEFixer still reads it from the search box label.
TAKE also finds the search box by the game's own label in the game language, so clients whose label the plugin did not know work too.
In a non-English game the search also finds the game's own word for Corrupted and the waystone reward lines (Item Rarity, Monster Pack Size and the others).

plugins.name: Radar
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Draws nearby monsters, NPCs, chests, area transitions and the walkable map on the in-game large map.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
Chests, area transitions and Magic monsters are named as the game names them (Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish and Russian).

plugins.name: Ritual Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Highlights the Ritual rewards you want in the Favours window, shows their prices and defers them all with one click.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).

DEFER works in every game language (POEFixer 371 and later): the game's own "Defer Item" text is recognised in the game language, and the other button under the reward grid is taken for "Offer Tribute".
Rewards are matched to the item list and priced by their English name in every game language (POEFixer 371 and later), and unrevealed rewards are recognised in every game language.
Diagnostics show the button's text as the game writes it.

DEFER no longer waits in vain on a non-English client when a number or a short label sits just under the reward grid: the button found by its place is checked again until the game shows its "Defer Item" text on it.

Rewards ticked in the open Favours window under the game's own names (as 1.5.8 asked on a non-English client) are highlighted and deferred again; unticking such a reward there clears both its English and its game name.
A reward the program could not name yet (its item data still downloading) is named as soon as it can be, without reopening the Favours window.

plugins.name: Sekhema Helper
plugins.author: POEFixer
plugins.description: Trial of the Sekhemas helper: scores every room, recommends the best route to the boss and marks it on the in-game map.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages). Affliction names are the game's own names in each language.
Hotkey names show correctly with a non-English keyboard layout.
Long floor, timer and map label texts are no longer cut off.
The affliction search finds an affliction by its shown name or by its English name.
Weight lists sort by the shown name, and the history table columns fit their headers.
In the Overlays and Profiles settings a control that does not fit on its line moves to the next line instead of being cut off at the window edge.
The shipped profiles "Default" and "No-Hit" show their translated names until you change them.
The bronze, silver and gold caches in Traditional Chinese and the Grand Spectrum in Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Korean use the game's own names.

plugins.name: Skill DPS
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Shows the game's own DPS for each skill on your skill-bar icons, plus an optional movable list of every evaluated skill including minions.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).

plugins.name: Tablet Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Highlights Precursor Tablets in your inventory, stash, guild stash and merchant windows, coloured by type and filtered by bonuses, roll values and uses left.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
Tablet names and bonus lines read as the game words them in each language, and the bonus search and the bonus order follow the translated names.
The bonus search also finds a bonus by its English name, in any program language.

plugins.name: Waystone Helper
plugins.author: Omer Faruk ARPA, POEFixer
plugins.description: Marks waystones in your inventory and stash with affix-count, map-stat and affix-group badges, coloured borders by your own rules, and a hover breakdown.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
Affix lines read as the game words them in each language, and the affix filter finds affixes by their translated text.

plugins.name: Where Are You Going
plugins.author: KaiEKum, POEFixer
plugins.description: Draws a ring on the ground around rare and unique monsters (or any rarity you pick) and can show a line to where each one is going.
changes: Follows the program language (ten languages).
